description: Use this tool when a brand wants Digital Product Passports (DPP), QR codes and a consumer page for its products, in one step. INPUT: products (name, sku, gtin, composition, country of manufacture, care, materials... any shape, same as create_product_twin) and optionally units per product (how many physical units will carry a serial QR). For each product it creates the live twin in Cycle, publishes the versioned passport when the data is complete and the GTIN is valid (otherwise a 'preparatory' passport that lists what is missing) and returns the twin URL, the passport URL and a QR (SVG link ready to print). Free up to 1,000,000 physical units per connected free workspace (total, not monthly). Brand and product data are stored in Cycle under the connected brand.
